treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Estonia and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2014)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 38. | Luxembourg | 25.04.2002 | 23.05.2006 | 13.12.2006 ( est/eng ) | 23.01.2007 | 01.01.2008- 01.01.2016 |
source_title: EE-LU Convention 2014 with Protocol, English text (Luxemb_ingl.pdf embedded in Riigi Teataja act 227022015003)

rates.quote: a) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
1. Interest arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.quote: Estonia reserved MLI Art. 35(7)(a); its Art. 35(7)(b) notifications (25.11.2021, 01.06.2022) do not include this treaty, so the MLI (incl. PPT) has not yet effect.

notes: 2014 Convention replaced the 2006 convention (applied 2008-2015). Dividend 0% tier drafted as a 0% cap. Protocol I: collective investment vehicles (SICAV, SICAF, SICAR, FCP; Estonian funds) treated as residents and beneficial owners. Both States list the treaty under the MLI but Estonia has not notified Art. 35(7)(b) completion for Luxembourg.
